meta.name: graphql-architect
meta.description: Use when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, or building real-time subscriptions. Invoke for schema design, resolvers with DataLoader, query optimization, federation directives.

copy.tagline: 设计 GraphQL schema 并优化查询性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在构建或维护 GraphQL API
copy.tagline_en: Design GraphQL schemas and optimize query performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining a GraphQL API

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude成为GraphQL架构师，能设计模式、实现Apollo Federation、优化查询性能，并生成带DataLoader的解析器代码。
howto.when: 当你提到GraphQL、Apollo Federation、GraphQL模式、API图、GraphQL订阅、Apollo Server、模式设计、GraphQL解析器、DataLoader等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个电商的GraphQL模式，包含产品和用户类型。
为我的子图添加Apollo Federation的@key指令。
say.note: Claude会修改模式并验证组合。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a GraphQL architect who can design schemas, implement Apollo Federation, optimize query performance, and generate resolver code with DataLoader patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like GraphQL, Apollo Federation, GraphQL schema, API graph, GraphQL subscriptions, Apollo Server, schema design, GraphQL resolvers, DataLoader, etc.

say_en.text: Design a GraphQL schema for an e-commerce site with Product and User types.
say_en.note: Claude will generate SDL schema definitions.

say_en.text: How to solve N+1 query problem using DataLoader?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a DataLoader implementation example.

say_en.text: Add Apollo Federation @key directives to my subgraph.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the schema and validate composition.
